userIntent: Continue Bauman Hub continuously in Chat control plane, skip Codex execution for now, and prepare one complete Hub-only implementation packet without touching subject prompts or subject-app internals.
objective: Clean learner-facing sample/mock truth from Subjects and Research/Thesis, preserve Schedule as Hub-owned canonical planning, distinguish unknown/stale/current subject summaries, converge the five primary pages onto one presentation owner each, and migrate Hub-side subject integration toward registered descriptor/capability/launch adapters while preserving legacy compatibility behind the adapter.
targetArea: Bauman Hub five-page runtime truth, presentation ownership, and Hub-side subject integration boundary
forbiddenPaths: control-service mutations unrelated to this Hub learner UX cleanup
acceptanceCriteria: Start from current main baseline b6df392c5ab935bed4924b07b9bbe2e95efb2c8e or report and reconcile a newer main before editing.
Normal Subjects runtime no longer presents fixed 2025 semester/calendar/deadline/note/session/teacher/progress fixtures as current learner facts.
Subjects cards are built from Hub-owned registered subject descriptors and approved normalized summaries; missing external summary data renders as unavailable rather than fabricated zero/progress.
Normal learner Subjects UI does not expose direct openSubjectEditor/editorPath authoring access unless a registered explicit authoring capability exists.
Subject launch is routed through a Hub-side launch adapter/descriptor abstraction; legacy mainPath may exist only behind the compatibility adapter and is not consumed directly by page presentation.
Hub normalized subject read model distinguishes CURRENT, STALE and UNAVAILABLE and retains provenance/freshness metadata when available.
Home and Roadmap do not coerce missing subject progress into real 0%; aggregates report partial data coverage and average only approved known values.
Roadmap curriculum/stage/course data remains Hub-owned and compatible with current study-plan coverage; no subject internals are used.
Schedule day/week/month, priorities, workload and notes remain derived from Hub-owned schedule/local Hub state and do not regress.
Research/Thesis no longer defaults to March/April 2025 tasks, fixed 65% progress, static chapter percentages, sample heatmap, canned notes or canned personalized AI items as live state.
Unconfigured Research/Thesis renders an explicit empty/setup state and uses Hub-owned research workspace data once configured.
Exactly five primary learner routes remain visible: home, roadmap, subjects, schedule and research; no duplicate primary navigation is introduced.
Each primary route has one presentation owner; historical compatibility hooks may remain but must not compete by re-rendering the same route after the owner.
Responsive behavior remains usable at desktop 1366/1440/1920, tablet 744/768/820/1024 and phone 375/390/393/430 widths.
Keyboard focus, readable shared typography, contrast semantics and important touch targets remain compliant with the shared UI constitution.
No file under prompts/subjects/** or subjects/** is read as implementation input, modified, or required for acceptance.
No new concrete subject endpoint is invented; only registered logical capabilities and existing approved transports/contracts are used.
Current Device Gate/auth/PWA/offline behavior is not weakened by this learner Hub cleanup.
Execution result records exact before/after SHA, changed paths, tests, screenshot/browser evidence summary, acceptance matrix and boundary compliance.
No production publish occurs until exact implementation SHA passes Chat review.
testPlan: Static scan Subjects and Research/Thesis learner runtime for fixed 2025 fixture truth, fallbackProgress and other demo/reference defaults that can render as current facts.
Static/browser test that missing progress produces an unavailable state and is not rendered as 0% unless explicit evidence says 0.
Static/browser test that stale summary renders stale provenance/freshness state.
Static test that Subjects learner presentation does not call openSubjectEditor or consume editorPath directly.
Static/browser test for launch adapter behavior including available and unavailable subject launch states.
Roadmap test for partial progress coverage and no unknown-as-zero aggregation.
Schedule regression tests for day/week/month, planning controls, notes, priorities, upcoming items and subject launch handoff.
Research/Thesis tests for empty first-run state, Hub-owned task/milestone/note persistence, and absence of fixed mock progress.
Responsive browser/screenshots at required desktop/tablet/phone widths with no horizontal page overflow or overlapping primary controls.
Accessibility checks for keyboard reachability, visible focus, text labels and truth-state text independent of color.
Run existing future-interface-system, development-fast, subjects-reference, schedule-reference and thesis-reference gates affected by the diff.
Diff-scope check proving zero changes under prompts/subjects/** and subjects/**.
Return exact HEAD SHA and explicit statement of Device Gate/auth/PWA/offline regression status.
releasePolicy: IMPLEMENTATION_MAY_BE_PREPARED_AND_TESTED_ON_A_FRESH_BRANCH_FROM_CURRENT_MAIN; DO_NOT_MERGE_OR_PUBLISH UNTIL NORMAL CHAT REVIEWS AND ACCEPTS THE EXACT HEAD SHA. USER HAS CURRENTLY DEFERRED CODEX EXECUTION.
rollbackNotes: Keep the change additive and adapter-first. If regression occurs, revert the Hub cleanup commits only; preserve current main curriculum/control changes and all subject-app state.
